name: agent-blue
description: Analytics agent platform with Snowflake + dbt support

scripts.tunnel: cloudflared tunnel --loglevel warn --transport-loglevel warn --config cloudflared-agent-blue.yml run agent-blue-slack
scripts.slack:local: concurrently -k -n tunnel,slack -c cyan,green "npm run tunnel" "npm run slack:server"
scripts.admin:dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,tunnel -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run admin:api" "npm run admin:web:dev" "npm run tunnel"
scripts.sandbox:local: AGENT_BLUE_ENV_FILE=.env SANDBOX_DOMAIN=localhost SANDBOX_HTTP_PORT=8080 SANDBOX_HTTPS_PORT=8443 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.sandbox.yml up -d --build proxy admin slack
scripts.sandbox:local:down: AGENT_BLUE_ENV_FILE=.env SANDBOX_DOMAIN=localhost SANDBOX_HTTP_PORT=8080 SANDBOX_HTTPS_PORT=8443 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.sandbox.yml down
scripts.sandbox:local:ps: AGENT_BLUE_ENV_FILE=.env SANDBOX_DOMAIN=localhost SANDBOX_HTTP_PORT=8080 SANDBOX_HTTPS_PORT=8443 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.sandbox.yml ps
scripts.deploy: sh -lc 'ssh -i "$HOME/.ssh/DO" root@5.78.178.31 "cd /root/agent-blue && git pull && docker compose up -d --build && docker image prune -f && docker builder prune -f"'
